title: Golden Harvest Glow

diffuser.notes: Use in a cool-mist diffuser for a cozy, warm ambiance.

why_it_works: Sweet orange lifts with bright citrus warmth, cinnamon adds a snug spice, and patchouli grounds with earthy depth—together they capture autumn’s golden transition.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
Cinnamon bark is a skin sensitizer—use at low dilution and limit exposure.
